verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document auto-shutdown timers, idle-instance termination, budget caps, or spend limits for CoreWeave. Node Pool quotas are capacity limits rather than spend limits, and billing insights, the FOCUS API, and Grafana cost views only report usage after the fact. Cluster Autoscaler scales on workload demand, which is related but is not a shutdown timer or spending cap.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill
